section_header: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Vacuum Switching Valve (VSV)
title: VACUUM SWITCHING VALVE (VSV)
subtitle: (See page AC-22)

content.description: VSV connected to battery terminals showing pipes labeled G, F, and E with air flow direction
VSV connected to battery terminals showing different pipe configuration with labeled connections
Ohmmeter connected to VSV terminals to check for short circuit
Ohmmeter connected to VSV terminals to measure resistance for open circuit check

items.title: CHECK VACUUM CIRCUIT CONTINUITY IN VSV BY BLOWING AIR INTO PIPES

steps.label: (a)
steps.text: Connect the VSV terminals to the battery terminals as illustrated.

steps.label: (b)
steps.text: Blow into pipe "F" and check that air comes out of pipe "E".

steps.label: (d)
steps.text: Blow into pipe "F" and check that air comes out of the filter "G".

items.action: If a problem is found, repair or replace the VSV.

items.title: CHECK FOR SHORT CIRCUIT
items.text: Using an ohmmeter, check that there is no continuity between each terminal and the VSV body.
items.action: If there is continuity, replace the VSV.

items.title: CHECK FOR OPEN CIRCUIT
items.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between the two terminals.
items.action: If resistance is not within specification, replace the VSV.
